items.title: FastTrackr AI Introduces First AI-Native Platform Built to Run Advisor Transitions
items.label: Press Release
items.imageAlt: FastTrackr AI Leadership Team, from left to right; Vineet Mohan, Kartik Kumar, Pradhumn Vijayvargiya
items.excerpt: An advisor team moved roughly $100 million across 150 households in two weeks, with zero repapering NIGOs, on the first AI-native platform built to run advisor transitions end to end.
